title: Red Hat Security Advisory: squid security update
description: A security vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-61642 affects the Squid proxy caching server, specifically involving HTTP request smuggling via the Transfer-Encoding header. Red Hat has issued an important security update for Squid in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support to address this issue. The vulnerability is rated with a high severity impact by Red Hat Product Security. The update is available through official Red Hat advisories and packages.
